candidates.title: Ancient Egypt Unveiled: Treasures from Egyptian Museums
candidates.blurb: Egyptian state museums lend material rarely seen outside Cairo; a geopolitical hedge packaged as Pharaonic splendour.

candidates.title: The Hong Kong Jockey Club Series: Treasures of the Mughal Court from the Victoria and Albert Museum
candidates.blurb: V&A loans Mughal miniatures and jade to a city with deep South Asian commercial ties but little institutional memory.

candidates.title: Wonders of Imperial Carpets: Masterpieces from the Museum of Islamic Art, Doha
candidates.blurb: Doha's MIA loans Safavid and Ottoman textiles, underscoring Hong Kong's evolving role as neutral ground for Gulf cultural diplomacy.

candidates.title: A Movable Feast: The Culture of Food and Drink in China
candidates.blurb: Palace Museum ceramics and scrolls reframe banquet ritual; arrives as Hong Kong reconsiders its own food heritage amid gentrification.

candidates.title: The Forbidden City and The Palace of Versailles: China-France Cultural Encounters in the Seventeenth and Eighteenth Centuries
candidates.blurb: Jesuit clocks and Kangxi cartography trace early Sino-European exchange, lending historical depth to current Belt-and-Road aesthetics.

candidates.title: A History of China in Silk: The Chris Hall Collection at the Hong Kong Palace Museum
candidates.blurb: A British collector's textiles trace dynastic transitions; instructive on how private connoisseurship shapes public narrative in Hong Kong.

candidates.title: The Hong Kong Jockey Club Series: The Art of Armaments — Qing Dynasty Military Collection from The Palace Museum
candidates.blurb: Ceremonial armour and banners presented as decorative art; a carefully apolitical reading of state power.

candidates.title: Anne Imhof
candidates.blurb: Imhof's durational intensity lands in a former colonial prison complex; spatial friction guaranteed.

candidates.title: Alicja Kwade: Waiting Pavilions
candidates.blurb: Kwade's mirrored structures occupy a prison yard; site-specific only if the architecture is allowed to speak.

candidates.title: Fermata: Hong Kong in Venice — Collateral Event of the 61st International Art Exhibition – La Biennale di Venezia
candidates.blurb: Hong Kong's Venice collateral event previews at home; a rare chance to assess curatorial ambition before export.

candidates.title: Blooming: The Art of Gardens in East and West
candidates.blurb: East-West garden aesthetics compared in a city where public green space is contested political territory.

candidates.title: Proudly from Canton: The Muwen Tang Collection of Cantonese and Export Art
candidates.blurb: Export porcelain and trade paintings trace Canton's mercantile lineage; directly relevant to Hong Kong's current identity negotiation.

candidates.title: Dreamchasers: Stories of Hong Kong Art
candidates.blurb: Local artists from the museum's own collection; worth checking for curatorial courage or institutional caution.
